title: Power-To-Liquid (PTL) Kerosene and Opportunities to Introduce Green Hydrogen in Aviation
content:
Abstract

During the past years, power-derived fuels have moved into the center of the debate on a future renewable energy supply for the aviation sector, due to a continued need for liquid fuels in aviation and serious concerns about the sustainability of biofuel production at the scale of future fuel demand. Basic characteristics of kerosene synthesis via power-to-liquid pathways are reviewed with focus on the application of synthetic kerosenes in civil aviation. Furthermore, alternative use cases for green hydrogen in aviation are discussed.
